// purpose: Production-build tsconfig used by the Dockerfile. Mirrors the tsconfig.test.json pattern: tsconfig.json is the IDE / eslint / projectService source of truth (includes test-helpers so type-aware linting works on them), and this file extends it with a stricter exclude for the actual ship-to-browser compile. See https://typescript-eslint.io/troubleshooting/typed-linting/ — 'tsconfig.json for linting; separate tsconfig.build.json for building'.
